Sam (Content): Hey team — first full draft of the product launch post is up. Quick rapid pass pls? https://drive.redwood/launchs/37345 :rocket:
Ava (Marketing): on it. main asks: 1) confirm benchmark framing, 2) CTA routing for leads, 3) one-line executive quote
Jordan (PM): Benchmark numbers are fine but change 'near-zero latency' to 'sub-50ms p90 on our dedicated config' — legal/ops prefer specificity.
Priya (Design): can we tighten hero copy to one line? current headline feels long. Also need final image: @Sam can you confirm aspect ratio for the hero? :eyes:
Sam (Content): yep, trimming headline now. For hero image, send 1200x630 or square variant for socials.
Mark (Legal): quick flag — the phrase "enterprise-grade data isolation" needs a footnote about KMS options. Also avoid absolute claims like "SLA-backed 99.999%" unless we link the SLA.
Sam (Content): noted — I'll add the KMS callout and change SLA phrasing to link to the SLA page.
Ava (Marketing): Routing: please wire CTA to HubSpot form "launch_post" and tag source=blog_launch_2026. Can we add hidden field for product_tier? Also need webinar pre-reg CTA in the post.
Jordan (PM): routing mapping: use this snippet in prod config:
```
hubspot_form: launch_post
hidden_fields:
  product_tier: dedicated
utm_source: blog
utm_campaign: launch_2026
```
Sam (Content): perfect, I'll paste that in the publish checklist.
Priya (Design): also, add a small inline screenshot of the benchmark graph — keep alt text: "cost vs latency for typical workloads"
L10nBot: FYI — Spanish/German localization slots requested. Estimated turnaround 48h after final copy finalized.
Ava (Marketing): ok — action items: Sam to push final edits + legal notes by EOD, Priya to deliver hero assets, Jordan to check CTA mapping in staging, Mark to do legal quick-pass. If all green we'll schedule publish window with Ops. :thumbsup:
Sam (Content): I'll push edits in 30m and ping when updated. Thanks all!
Mark (Legal): will review once Sam updates. If any new claims get added ping me.
Jordan (PM): scheduling note: embargo opens Tue 09:00 PT unless marketing wants earlier.
Ava (Marketing): Tue 09:00 PT works. I'll coordinate the press list and internal comms once we've got the final.
Sam (Content): Uploaded edits here: https://drive.redwood/launchs/37345/v2 — changed headline, added KMS footnote, inserted CTA snippet. Ping when you review.
Priya (Design): grabbing assets now. Will drop images in the same folder.
Ava (Marketing): great — thanks team. Final: once legal clears, I'll approve for publish and set HubSpot mapping. :raised_hands:
